body.title: Use staged views across recovery publication and cleanup
body.summary: Convert warm/cold phase handoff, history binding/evidence, publication and approval cleanup to the same bounded descriptor traversal; remove aggregate reader.view inventory loading.
acceptanceChecks: Matching authorized warm handoff/publication/cleanup reconstructs zero sources and invokes zero models; cold restart discards authority and fully qualifies required scope/history once with bounded windows.

All pinned submitted values, feedback/actions/failures and origin witnesses survive exact publication/permanent round-trip; old derived encoding cannot become authority or trigger unsafe cache deletion.

Preserve result-before-progress ordering, native open/disposal fences and durable cleanup-only claim; canceled active windows and partial stage/seal/promotion/reopen/cleanup failures retain exact evidence/reservations and allow only explicit safe recovery.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Bounded warm/cold recovery publication and cleanup: full feedback round-trip, zero warm source/model calls, old derived version rejection, history/native/cleanup crash and authority invariants.
